summary.title: Changes Overview
summary.info: Click 'Detail' in the toolbar to see detailed changes per phase, or 'Commit' to create a Git commit.

repo.needsAttributes: The audit repository does not enforce canonical .tara.json handling (LF/text). Set .gitattributes to avoid unnecessary diff noise.
repo.notARepo: This project file is not inside a Git repository.

config.title: Git Configuration
config.patInfo: Personal Access Token will be securely stored in your system keychain.
config.patHelp: Enter your PAT with 'repo' permissions. Leave empty to keep existing token.
config.sshInfo: SSH authentication uses your system's SSH keys (~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.ssh/id_ed25519).
config.sshKeyPathHelp: Leave empty to use default SSH key
config.gpgInfo: GPG signing ensures your commits are cryptographically verified. Your private key will be securely stored.
config.gpgKeyIdHelp: Enter the last 8 characters of your GPG key ID
config.gpgPrivateKeyHelp: Paste your armored private key. Leave empty to keep existing key or generate new one.

signers.title: Authorized signers
signers.help: Keys allowed to sign audit commits (.tara/allowed_signers). Adding or removing one is itself a signed audit: commit.
signers.noRepo: Open a project inside its audit repo to manage signers.
signers.principalHelp: The commit-author email of the signer — must match how they commit.
signers.maintainerAdd: Grant maintainer role (may change the manifest)
signers.noMaintainer: This manifest has no maintainer — no one can change it. Promote a signer to maintainer.

warnings.notConfigured: Git configuration incomplete. Please configure Git settings before committing.

protection.noRepo: Open a project inside its audit repo to see protection status.
protection.noTrail: No audit trail yet — the checklist appears once the signer manifest is committed.
protection.allGood: All locally verifiable checks pass. Complete the host settings below to prevent history rewrites.
protection.someFail: Some locally verifiable checks failed — see below.
protection.dontAutoShow: Don't warn me at commit time for this repository
protection.hostNote: Host settings can't be verified locally — this is guidance, not a live status check.

verify.title: Audit trail verification
verify.subtitle: Reconstructs the signing authority from the committed history and reports any commit that isn't authorized by the manifest as it stood before it.
verify.noAnchor: No audit anchor yet — add a signer manifest (Signers tab) first.
